claims.sourceText: OSD FOIA final response, case 25-F-3514, September 2025
claims.text: In September 2025 OSD responded in FOIA case 25-F-3514 that after 'thorough searches of the electronic records and files of CMD, no records of the kind you described could be identified' regarding the alleged Yankee Blue cessation memo.

OSD's final response in FOIA case 25-F-3514 (September 2025) stated that after 'thorough searches of the electronic records and files of CMD, no records of the kind you described could be identified' regarding the alleged spring 2023 cessation memo.

topics.title: Perception management: YANKEE BLUE, psychological operations and disinformation practice
